name: Sakuraba Asuka
source:
Asuka is an ordinary high school student who's bored with her mundane life, and wonders if her uneventful days is what "happiness" truly is. She wishes for stimulation, as well as for her ordinary existence to be more important. Her wish comes true when a mysterious voice tells her to come to Wonderland, an exciting world where she's considered "the ultimate, delicious meal". 

Though negative and lacking in self-esteem, her boredom fuels her curious nature and compels her to enjoy Wonderland to the fullest. Easily swept away when amused, Asuka finds herself changing, as well as changing those around her. She loves to shop and her favourite food is cheesecake.
